description: Inference-only context-dependence diagnostic. Three input conditions evaluated on the same fixed checkpoint. No retraining was performed between conditions.
source_run_notes: Separately trained checkpoint using the same configuration and seed as the selected H1_DROP10_S45 run (ELECTRA, LoRA r=16, alpha=32, dropout=0.10, all-linear, lr=2e-4, seed=45, epochs=5). The original H1_DROP10_S45 adapter was not retained in the repository (gitignored); this ablation checkpoint was trained specifically for this diagnostic. Full-input scores differ slightly from H1_DROP10_S45 (DEV960: 0.8994 vs 0.9014; DEV600: 0.8686 vs 0.8675) due to training stochasticity at this seed — the three inference conditions all use the same H1_DROP10_S45_ABLATION checkpoint.

conditions.description: Original context, question, and claim as provided in the evaluation file.
Context field is empty string; original question and claim are retained. This is NOT a claim-only condition — the model receives both question and claim.

Context is replaced by a different context from the same evaluation set using a fixed seed-0 permutation. Self-matches are prevented. Shuffling is not constrained to the same domain. Original question and claim are retained.
